'''Greg Hitt'''<ref name="dt-14602">[http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/14602 TIC TAC TOE 3  X'S IN A ROW], DeckTech (Greg "SonOfaSith" Hitt, 15 March 2001). Preservation copies: [https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/14602/ Stephen Skilton]; [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/14602/ GitHub Pages].</ref> (DeckTech handle '''SonOfaSith''') posted a [[Light]] list on DeckTech in March 2001. He finished 7th of 15 at the Winter Break NYC Open Qualifier at Neutral Ground in New York on 8 January 2005.<ref name="pcf-4273-59872" />
